agents.name: Signup Welcome Agent
agents.description: Monitors new free signups, enriches them, scores them, and sends personalized welcome + onboarding sequences

agents.name: Product-Qualified Lead Hunter
agents.description: Monitors product usage signals (apps created, API connections, user invites) and triggers outreach when accounts hit PQL thresholds

agents.name: Trial Nurture Agent
agents.description: Tracks trial users (Business plan 15-day trial), sends usage-based nudges, and escalates to sales when engagement is high

agents.name: Expansion Opportunity Agent
agents.description: Monitors existing customers for expansion signals (new workspaces, user growth approaching tier limits, new use cases)

agents.name: Churned User Reactivation Agent
agents.description: Identifies users who stopped using Appsmith and sends re-engagement sequences based on their last activity and new features released since

agents.name: Appsmith Agents Cross-Sell Agent
agents.description: Identifies existing Appsmith customers who are good fits for Appsmith Agents based on their tech stack (Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack) and team composition
